tickets.title: Obtain federal estimated tax payment confirmation
tickets.text: Obtain the federal estimated tax payment confirmation for the Willowdoodle household, which files joint federal and Colorado returns with Lena Dewspindle, CPA. Serena Willowdoodle saw the state payment voucher in the CPA portal but not the corresponding federal payment confirmation before the next payment window.
tickets.evidence: The agreed work is to obtain the corresponding federal payment confirmation, dated 2024-12-24.

tickets.title: Provide consolidated open service matter status log
tickets.text: Provide Serena Willowdoodle one consolidated written log showing each unresolved operational issue, the responsible party, and the next status checkpoint. Prior updates arrived in separate portal messages and emails; Serena prefers secure portal delivery with urgent operational matters also summarized by email.
tickets.evidence: The agreed work is to provide the consolidated written log, dated 2024-12-18.

tickets.title: Restore read-only Teacup Comet Bank dashboard access
tickets.text: Restore read-only access to the Teacup Comet Bank cash dashboard for the Willowdoodle household because the prior authorization no longer appears active. The household holds about $148,000 in checking and savings at Teacup Comet Bank after the $30,000 contractor deposit.
tickets.evidence: The agreed work is to restore read-only dashboard access, dated 2024-12-19.

tickets.title: Coordinate temporary mailing and delivery setup
tickets.text: Coordinate the temporary mailing and delivery setup for the Willowdoodle household, which is using a temporary mailing address during the home renovation. Recent account correspondence still reflected the prior delivery setup.
tickets.evidence: The agreed work is to coordinate the temporary mailing and delivery setup, dated 2024-12-27.

tickets.title: Correct custodian login security routing
tickets.text: Correct the custodian login security routing at Velvet Acorn Custody because Jasper Willowdoodle received authentication texts tied to Serena Willowdoodle's IRA login, which does not match the household's intended credential separation.
tickets.evidence: The agreed work is to correct the custodian login security routing, dated 2024-12-17.

tickets.title: Resolve duplicate Jasper portal profile
tickets.text: Resolve the duplicate Jasper Willowdoodle profile in the portal, which prevented Jasper from completing an electronic signature packet for household records. Confirm the signature packet can be completed once the duplicate is removed.
tickets.evidence: The agreed work is to resolve the duplicate Jasper profile issue affecting the electronic signature packet, dated 2024-12-20.

tickets.title: Address taxable account cost basis feed discrepancy
tickets.text: Address the cost basis feed discrepancy in the joint taxable account at Velvet Acorn Custody, where the data feed shows missing lot-level basis for three positions while the custodian statement shows basis amounts for those same holdings. Reconcile the feed to the statement.
tickets.evidence: The agreed work is to address the taxable account cost basis feed discrepancy, dated 2024-12-23.

tickets.title: Address trusted contact field inconsistency
tickets.text: Address the trusted contact field inconsistency at Velvet Acorn Custody: the joint taxable account lists a trusted contact, but Serena Willowdoodle's IRA profile does not show a trusted contact entry in the custodian records. Confirm and align the entries.
tickets.evidence: The agreed work is to address the trusted contact field inconsistency, dated 2025-01-03.

tickets.title: Revise renovation reserve reporting classification
tickets.text: Revise the household performance report so the renovation reserve is not classified under long-term portfolio assets. Serena Willowdoodle tracks that cash separately from investable reserves and uses portal account nicknames to distinguish renovation cash from long-term reserves.
tickets.evidence: The agreed work is to revise the renovation reserve reporting classification, dated 2024-12-31.

tickets.title: Address billing account group mismatch
tickets.text: Address the billing account group mismatch for the Willowdoodle household: the billing review screen still includes a closed zero-balance account, creating a mismatch between the invoice allocation view and current managed accounts. Remove the closed account from the group.
tickets.evidence: The agreed work is to address the billing account group mismatch, dated 2024-12-30.

tickets.title: Obtain employer disability certificate from Pocket Lantern Robotics
tickets.text: Obtain the formal employer disability certificate from the Pocket Lantern Robotics employer portal for Serena Willowdoodle. The planning file has only a benefits summary for her disability coverage, which replaces 60% of base salary subject to a monthly cap; the certificate describes the monthly cap and exclusions.
tickets.evidence: the employer disability certificate remains a concrete unresolved issue for follow-up, dated 2025-01-10.

tickets.title: Obtain trustee powers page for trust certification
tickets.text: Obtain the missing page describing trustee powers from the trust certification prepared by Coral Badger Law Group for the Willowdoodle estate plan. The custodian has not accepted the trust registration update without that page, so the certification excerpt must be completed to finish account registration.
tickets.evidence: trust certification support for account registration remains a concrete unresolved issue for follow-up, dated 2025-01-06.
